text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Black textured cropped jacket with white frayed trims over white blouse with sewn long ribbon bow, black micro shorts, sheer black tights shown hollow, black peep-toe pumps.
original_prompt: Edit this hollow wardrobe product photo: remove all flesh-colored legs, knees and anatomical body surface from inside the tights. Keep ONLY empty translucent gray-black hosiery fabric with the white background showing through it; preserve any fabric pattern. Also remove the detachable silver necklace/choker, preserving the attached white blouse ribbon bow. Keep all garments, shoes, materials and cuts otherwise unchanged. Pure white backdrop, fully uncropped portrait 2:3. No body, skin, mannequin or new objects.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
